resources.string: This action cannot be undone. The preset will be removed permanently.
This will permanently delete every preset and cannot be undone.
This mode disables all throttling and may cause system instability or freezes with screen capture animations.
RAGNAROK sends LED commands as fast as possible and can overwhelm your device. Use only if you understand the risks.
This app is currently in beta and may cause crashes or unstable behavior.
This app is provided for free and you should not be charged for obtaining it. It is available for free on this GitHub repo: exemplegithubrepo
Do you want to save the current values to the selected preset before closing?
Animations now switch automatically based on the foreground app.
In this mode, swiping presets will not change the running animation. Assign apps to presets in settings to control what plays automatically.
Allows the app to send LED animations and presets to Bifrost.
Bifrost uses Accessibility screenshot capture to sample your screen continuously without repeating capture prompts.
Allows Bifrost to capture display frames for LED ambient effects.
Needed for App Profile mode so Bifrost can detect foreground apps and auto-switch presets.
You can now start Bifrost and keep it running in background until you press Stop or Kill.
One small network request at launch
Bifrost can check the plugin store for updates each time it starts.\n\nThis is off by default. You can change it anytime in the Plugin Store.
Ambient and AmbiAurora will look less fluid

Accessibility capture never asks for permission again, but it samples the screen more slowly, so Ambient and AmbiAurora animations lose smoothness.\n\nScreen capture stays fluid and is the default. It asks for permission once per launch.
Allows Bifrost to capture display frames for LED effects.
